commitMessage:
Apply Pantauku vivid orange theme with rounded card style

- Primary vivid orange (#FF6A00, #FF8A3D in dark mode), light grey
  background with white surfaces
- Pill buttons without uppercase, rounded inputs, cards and dialogs,
  soft shadows, rounded map controls
- Selected list items get an orange tint and left accent bar
- Server colorPrimary/colorSecondary attributes still override defaults
